Option Explicit '====================================================================== ' Error Handling ' 2015-06-22 '====================================================================== Public Function ErrHandler(ByVal dErrNum As Double, ByVal szErrDescrip As String, ByVal szScrn As String, ByVal szSub As String, Optional ByVal ftdSevLevel As ftDiagSeverityConstants = ftDiagSeverityError, Optional ByVal szMsg As String = "") As Boolean On Error GoTo ErrHndl Dim bReturn As Boolean
'Initalize bReturn = True
'Log Error Information to FTDiagnostics Call Application.LogDiagnosticsMessage("VBA Error Handler - " & szScrn & "." & szSub & " Error #" & dErrNum & ": " & szErrDescrip, ftdSevLevel)
'Show Message Box and Log Message Information to FTDiagnostics when appropiate If szMsg <> "" Then MsgBox szMsg, vbOKOnly, "HMI VBA Error Handler" Call Application.LogDiagnosticsMessage("VBA Error Handler (MESSAGE) - " & szScrn & "." & szSub & " Message: " & szMsg, ftDiagSeverityInfo) End If
ErrHndl: If Err.Number <> 0 Then Call Application.LogDiagnosticsMessage("VBA Error Handler - " & ThisDisplay.Name & ".errHandle Error # " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description & ".", ftDiagSeverityError) bReturn = False End If ErrHandler = bReturn End Function

Option Explicit '=========================================================== ' Class CTagGroup ' mur 2015-06-22 '=========================================================== Public WithEvents Hnd As TagGroup Attribute Hnd.VB_VarHelpID = -1
Public Sub CreateGroup(AreaName As String, RefreshTime As Integer) On Error GoTo ErrHndl
If Hnd Is Nothing Then: Set Hnd = Application.CreateTagGroup(AreaName, RefreshTime) Exit Sub
ErrHndl: If Err.Number <> 0 Then Call ErrHandler(Err.Number, Err.Description, ThisDisplay.Name, "Create TagGroup") End If End Sub
Public Sub WriteValue(Indx As Integer, Value As Variant) On Error GoTo ErrHndl Dim oTag As Tag
If Not Hnd Is Nothing Then Set oTag = Hnd.Item(Indx) oTag.Value = Value End If Exit Sub
ErrHndl: If Err.Number <> 0 Then Call ErrHandler(Err.Number, Err.Description, ThisDisplay.Name, "Write Tag") End If End Sub
Public Function GetValue(Indx As Integer) As Variant On Error GoTo ErrHndl Dim oTag As Tag Dim Value As Variant
If Not Hnd Is Nothing Then Set oTag = Hnd.Item(Indx) Value = oTag.Value End If GetValue = Value Exit Function
ErrHndl: If Err.Number <> 0 Then Call ErrHandler(Err.Number, Err.Description, ThisDisplay.Name, "Read Tag") End If End Function

Option Explicit '====================================================================== ' Class CList ' mur 2015-07-06 ' mur 2015-09-11 ResetToItem '====================================================================== ' Properties '---------------------------------------------------------------------- 'Source Data Public Source As Collection Public SourceSize As Integer Public SelectedIndx As Integer ' index in List Public SelectedItem As CTypeUnit ' selected item
' View Resources Public View_ItemText As Group Public View_ItemBack As Group Public View_btnDown As Button Public View_btnUp As Button Public View_Selected As Text
'Design Public BC_Active As Long Public BC_NotActive As Long Public Rows As Integer
'Private '---------------------------------------------------------------------- Private FirstRowIndx As Integer
'Methods '---------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Sub Reset() 'show first page If (View_ItemText Is Nothing) Or (View_ItemBack Is Nothing) Or (View_btnDown Is Nothing) Or (View_btnUp Is Nothing) Then Exit Sub
If SourceSize < 0 Then SourceSize = 0 If (SelectedIndx < 0) Or (SelectedIndx > SourceSize) Then: SelectedIndx = 0
FirstRowIndx = 1
Refresh End Sub
Public Sub ResetToItem() 'show selected Item page Dim pg As Integer If (View_ItemText Is Nothing) Or (View_ItemBack Is Nothing) Or (View_btnDown Is Nothing) Or (View_btnUp Is Nothing) Then Exit Sub
If SourceSize < 0 Then SourceSize = 0 If (SelectedIndx < 0) Or (SelectedIndx > SourceSize) Then: SelectedIndx = 0
If (SelectedIndx > 0) Then pg = Int((SelectedIndx - 1) / Rows) FirstRowIndx = 1 + (pg * Rows) Else FirstRowIndx = 1 End If
Refresh End Sub
Public Sub SelectItem(Row As Integer) 'Row = (0 to Rows-1) If (FirstRowIndx + Row <= SourceSize) Then SelectedIndx = FirstRowIndx + Row
Refresh End If End Sub
Public Sub PageDownChanged() If ((FirstRowIndx + Rows) <= SourceSize) Then FirstRowIndx = FirstRowIndx + Rows
Refresh End If End Sub
Public Sub PageUpChanged() If ((FirstRowIndx - Rows) > 0) Then FirstRowIndx = FirstRowIndx - Rows
Refresh End If End Sub
Private Sub Refresh() On Error GoTo ErrHndl
Dim i, j As Integer Dim ItemText As Text Dim ItemBack As Polygon Dim Highligted As Integer Dim Item As CTypeUnit
View_btnDown.Visible = ((FirstRowIndx + Rows) <= SourceSize) View_btnUp.Visible = ((FirstRowIndx - Rows) > 0)
Highligted = SelectedIndx - FirstRowIndx For i = 0 To Rows - 1 Set ItemText = View_ItemText.Elements.Item(i + 1) Set ItemBack = View_ItemBack.Elements.Item(i + 1)
If (FirstRowIndx + i <= SourceSize) Then 'Fill item from Source j = FirstRowIndx + i Set Item = Source.Item(j) ItemText.Caption = Item.Name
'Highlight selected item If (i = Highligted) Then ItemBack.BackColor = BC_Active Else ItemBack.BackColor = BC_NotActive End If Else ItemText.Caption = "" ItemBack.BackColor = BC_NotActive End If Next i
'Selected Item If (SelectedIndx > 0) Then Set SelectedItem = Source.Item(SelectedIndx) End If
' View Selected Item if it's required If Not View_Selected Is Nothing Then If (SelectedIndx > 0) Then View_Selected.Caption = SelectedItem.Name Else View_Selected.Caption = "" End If End If Exit Sub
ErrHndl: If Err.Number <> 0 Then Call ErrHandler(Err.Number, Err.Description, ThisDisplay.Name, "Refresh") End If End Sub

Option Explicit '====================================================================== ' Class CHWData_01 ' mur 2015-11-21 '====================================================================== ' Properties '---------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Units As Collection
'Private '---------------------------------------------------------------------- Private AreaName As String Private Path As String Private UnitsNum As Integer ' from CPU Private OutputsNum As Integer Private WarehousesNum As Integer
'---------------------------------------------------------------------- Sub LoadObjectMap() ' !!!!! Specific '---------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo ErrHndl
Dim Tag As String Dim TagsInError As StringList Dim TG As New CTagGroup
TG.CreateGroup AreaName, 3000
Tag = Path + "HW_OutputsNum" TG.Hnd.Add Tag ' number of outputs
Tag = Path + "HW_WarehousesNum" TG.Hnd.Add Tag ' number of warehouses
' activate Tag Group TG.Hnd.Active = True TG.Hnd.RefreshFromSource TagsInError
' read values OutputsNum = TG.GetValue(1) WarehousesNum = TG.GetValue(2)
' deactivate group TG.Hnd.Active = False
Exit Sub
ErrHndl: If Err.Number <> 0 Then Call ErrHandler(Err.Number, Err.Description, ThisDisplay.Name, "Load object map") End If End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------- Private Sub LoadUnits() ' !!!!! Specific '---------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo ErrHndl
Dim i As Integer, j As Integer Dim Name As String Dim Tag As String Dim TagsInError As StringList Dim TG As New CTagGroup ' Tag group for loading outputs Dim Count As Integer TG.CreateGroup AreaName, 3000 If TG.Hnd Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
Count = OutputsNum
If Count > 0 Then
For i = 1 To Count
Tag = Path + "HW_Outputs[" + CStr(i) + "].Cfg.Group" TG.Hnd.Add Tag
Tag = Path + "HW_Outputs[" + CStr(i) + "].Cfg.Segment" TG.Hnd.Add Tag
Tag = Path + "HW_Outputs[" + CStr(i) + "].Cfg.ID" TG.Hnd.Add Tag
Tag = Path + "HW_Outputs[" + CStr(i) + "].Cfg.Name" TG.Hnd.Add Tag Next i
' activate Tag Group TG.Hnd.Active = True TG.Hnd.RefreshFromSource TagsInError
j = 1 For i = 1 To Count Dim Unit As New CTypeUnit
Unit.Group = TG.GetValue(j) 'Group(if 0 ... single output) j = j + 1 Unit.Segment = TG.GetValue(j) 'Segment j = j + 1 Unit.ID = TG.GetValue(j) 'ID j = j + 1 Unit.Name = TG.GetValue(j) 'Name j = j + 1
Units.Add Item:=Unit Set Unit = Nothing Next i End If
Count = WarehousesNum TG.Hnd.RemoveAll
If Count > 0 Then For i = 1 To Count
Tag = Path + "HW_Warehouses[" + CStr(i) + "].ID" TG.Hnd.Add Tag
Tag = Path + "HW_Warehouses[" + CStr(i) + "].Name" TG.Hnd.Add Tag Next i
' activate Tag Group TG.Hnd.Active = True TG.Hnd.RefreshFromSource TagsInError
j = 1 For i = 1 To Count Dim Unit2 As New CTypeUnit
Unit2.Group = 0 Unit2.Segment = 0
Unit2.ID = TG.GetValue(j) 'ID j = j + 1 Unit2.Name = TG.GetValue(j) 'Name j = j + 1
Units.Add Item:=Unit2 Set Unit2 = Nothing Next i End If
' deactivate group TG.Hnd.Active = False Exit Sub
ErrHndl: If Err.Number <> 0 Then Call ErrHandler(Err.Number, Err.Description, ThisDisplay.Name, "Load Data ****") End If End Sub
' Methods '---------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Sub LoadObjects(PAreaName As String) '---------------------------------------------------------------------- Set Units = New Collection
Path = "/::[PLC]" AreaName = PAreaName
' Load size of objects ' ------------------------------------------------------ LoadObjectMap ' -> Arrays size
' Load Outputs ' ------------------------------------------------------ If ((WarehousesNum + OutputsNum) > 0) And ((WarehousesNum + OutputsNum) < 51) Then: LoadUnits UnitsNum = Units.Count End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Sub FillUnitData(ByRef SourceData As Collection, ByRef TargetData As Collection, FilterNr As Integer, Optional ItemsOnly As Boolean = False) '---------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Filter units according to Group ' -1 : All units On Error GoTo ErrHndl Dim i As Integer
'Emptying collecton If TargetData.Count > 0 Then For i = 1 To TargetData.Count TargetData.Remove 1 Next i End If
'Filling data If Not ItemsOnly Then Dim Unit0 As New CTypeUnit Unit0.Name = " *** None *** " ' none item Unit0.ID = 0 TargetData.Add Item:=Unit0 End If
Dim Unit As CTypeUnit For Each Unit In SourceData
' single outputs - no groups items If FilterNr = 1 Then If ((Unit.Group = 0) And (Unit.Segment <> 0)) Then TargetData.Add Item:=Unit End If
' outputs - no groups items ElseIf FilterNr = 2 Then If (Unit.Group = 0) Then TargetData.Add Item:=Unit End If
' single outputs + warehouses ElseIf FilterNr = 3 Then If (Unit.Segment > 0) Or (Unit.ID > 1999) Then TargetData.Add Item:=Unit End If
' all outputs Else TargetData.Add Item:=Unit End If Next Unit Exit Sub
ErrHndl: If Err.Number <> 0 Then Call ErrHandler(Err.Number, Err.Description, ThisDisplay.Name, "Data fault") End If End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Function GetIndxFromList(ByRef SourceData As Collection, ItemID As Long) As Long '---------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo ErrHndl Dim Unit As CTypeUnit Dim i As Integer
i = 0 For Each Unit In SourceData i = i + 1 If (Unit.ID = ItemID) Then Exit For Next Unit GetIndxFromList = i Exit Function
ErrHndl: If Err.Number <> 0 Then Call ErrHandler(Err.Number, Err.Description, ThisDisplay.Name, "Data fault") End If End Function
